newsitem.title: GERMANY: Cologne airport plays down possible Frankfurt stake.
newsitem.headline: Cologne airport plays down possible Frankfurt stake.

text.p: Cologne/Bonn airport has played down reports that the Frankfurt airport authority could take a stake in its northern neighbour.

Lothar Ruschmeier, chairman of the Cologne/Bonn airport's supervisory board, said in an authority statement he was not aware that the German government, the state of North Rhine Westphalia or the city of Cologne were planning to sell their stakes.

Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) said on February 24 that it planned to hold cooperation talks with Cologne which could involve taking a stake in the authority but it denied media reports of a hostile takeover bid.
Cologne/Bonn airport saw double-figure growth in passengers and freight last year, the airport authority said.
Passenger numbers rose ten percent to more than 5.3 million
